subject: Status: estimation pipeline live, H spread across slices
body:
Status.

The estimation pipeline is reproduced and productionized from the colab: we compute the self-similarity exponent S, Hurst exponent H, and Joseph exponent J per corpus slice using per-token log-likelihood increments from our reference model. Sanity checks pass — on general web text we estimate H around 0.70, right where the paper puts it.

The interesting spread: our five slices range from H of about 0.61 (transactional/short-form text) to 0.74 (long-form technical), matching the intuition that long-range dependence tracks document coherence. Gustavo's pipeline runs a full slice overnight on the current allocation.

Risk for April: the correlation study's power depends on how many model/eval pairs Tomas's team can supply — with fewer than a dozen pairs the BPB-versus-fractal comparison won't be conclusive and we'd frame the readout as directional. Rafael is drafting the analysis plan to make that call explicit.

Wei
